utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone. For the purpose of today's hearing, we need to go into closed session. Yes, Mr. Harvey. We have a new member.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARVEY
utterances.text: Before we do that if I could introduce Mr. Alex Paredes-Penades from my team.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good morning. Welcome. Yes, Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. Before we go into closed session, if I could. Since all of the pleadings with respect to this next witness have been filed confidentially, I would just like to note for the public record that Dr. Karadzic has opposed the hearing of the testimony of this next witness in closed session. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. We go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Are there -- no. We are still in public session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
